name: Montage Laguna Beach
positioning: Oceanfront resort on a coastal bluff above the Pacific in Laguna Beach, designed like a California Craftsman-style village, with direct access to Treasure Island Beach
best_for: Families wanting a kids' club and rooms that can be conjoined
Travelers wanting ocean-view rooms, beach access and a large spa

facts.text: Montage Laguna Beach sits on a coastal bluff above the Pacific.
The property is designed to resemble a California Craftsman-style village.
Artwork in the rooms highlights local artists and scenes from Laguna Beach.
Dining includes Studio Mediterranean, The Loft, Mosaic Bar and Grille by the pool, and the Lobby Lounge.
The Studio Mediterranean menu draws on Mediterranean and Greek traditions with seasonal ingredients from California farms.
Spa Montage is a 20,000-square-foot indoor-outdoor facility.
The spa has a hydrotherapy circuit with a steam room, sauna, cold plunge and hot tub.
Charter Aperitivo excursions explore the coast by sea, including a Newport Harbor cruise and Emerald Bay or Catalina charters.
Standard guest rooms and suites can be conjoined to accommodate families.
Hiking and biking trails are nearby in Wood Canyons Wilderness Park and Crystal Cove State Park.

highlights.text: Every room has an ocean view plus a private balcony or patio.
The resort offers direct access to Treasure Island Beach.
In 2025 the hotel reopened its Mediterranean fine-dining restaurant, Studio Mediterranean, after nearly five years.
Beach Boot Camp, a guided beach walk and the Montage Yoga Ritual are offered daily and included for resort guests.
Paintbox and Paintbox Petite offer children crafts, arts, games and outdoor recreation in full and half-day sessions.

considerations.text: The hotel is at the southern tip of Laguna Beach, about a two-mile walk from downtown Laguna.
Tennis is arranged through the hotel's partnership with the nearby Laguna Niguel Racquet Club.
WhataHotel notes limited nearby dining options, so guests rely on the resort restaurants or travel.
